McKinsey Removes Partner from Leadership Role Over LinkedIn Posts

McKinsey & Co. has removed a senior partner from a leadership position within its research arm following online comments he made questioning the challenges faced by female executives. The partner's posts on LinkedIn reportedly touched upon the concept of the 'glass cliff,' a phenomenon where women are often promoted to precarious leadership positions during times of crisis.
